title: R6B district - maximum residential lot coverage for corner, interior and through lots (ZR 23-362 paragraph (a), standard lots)
description: DRAFT extraction (needs_review) of ZR 23-362 paragraph (a) 'For standard lots' (City of Yes for Housing Opportunity, Last Amended 2024-12-05) for R6B: maximum residential lot coverage 100 percent for a corner lot, 80 percent for an interior lot or a through lot, exactly as the paragraph states them for the districts it lists. The lot type is a site fact CONSUMED as the required input lot_type (corner / interior / through, for the zoning lot or the lot portion the caller evaluates); it is never derived here, and without it no value is emitted. The section lists 'R6 R7 R8 R9 R10 R11 R12' and does not name R6B: the value reaches R6B through ZR 11-25 (suffix inheritance), a reading flagged for the reviewer on every result. Paragraph (b) (eligible sites using Section 23-434) is not encoded. Own family residential_lot_coverage, so neither the maximum envelope nor the proposal checks (which read family lot_coverage) change. NOT a Verified determination: a candidate awaiting independent review and G6 qualified-human legal approval. Behind the lane A flag (lane_flag A): indexed only when LANE_A_ENABLED is on.

citations.quote: In the districts indicated, the maximum #residential# #lot coverage# for #interior lots# or #through lots# shall be 80 percent and the maximum #residential# #lot coverage# for #corner lots# shall be 100 percent.

All regulations applicable to a district designation shall be applicable to such district designation appended with a suffix, except as otherwise set forth in express provisions of this Resolution. If a section lists an R4 District, therefore, the provisions of that section shall also apply to R4-1, R4A and R4B Districts, unless separate provisions for the districts with suffixes are listed within such section.

inputs.name: zoning_district
inputs.description: Residence district governing the lot. Scope is enforced by applicability (in_set R6B), not an input enum: any other district is a visible not_applicable.

inputs.name: lot_type
inputs.description: Type of the zoning lot, or of the zoning-lot portion being evaluated, under the ZR 12-10 definitions of #corner lot#, #interior lot# and #through lot# (not captured). A site fact (Lane B) consumed as an input, never derived here. Not supplied -> no value: professional_review_required with missing_critical completeness naming lot_type.

inputs.name: overlay_present
inputs.description: True iff a commercial overlay is mapped on the lot (canonical profile zoning.commercial_overlays[] non-empty). Only adds the commercial-overlay note (exception commercial_overlay_not_captured); when not supplied the result escalates to professional review (fail-closed, DF-6).

inputs.name: special_district_present
inputs.description: True iff a special purpose district is mapped on the lot (canonical profile zoning.special_districts[] non-empty). When true -> professional_review_required; when not supplied -> professional_review_required (fail-closed, DF-6).

outputs.name: max_residential_lot_coverage_percent
outputs.description: Maximum residential lot coverage, in percent, for the supplied lot type (ZR 23-362(a)): corner lot 100, interior lot or through lot 80.

parameters.name: max_residential_lot_coverage_percent_by_lot_type
parameters.note: ZR 23-362(a) 'For standard lots': '#interior lots# or #through lots# shall be 80 percent' and '#corner lots# shall be 100 percent'. Keys equal the lot_type enum.

steps.note: ZR 23-362(a): maximum residential lot coverage (percent) for the supplied lot type - corner 100, interior or through 80.

exceptions.description: ZR 23-362 lists 'R6 R7 R8 R9 R10 R11 R12' and does not name R6B. This value reaches R6B through ZR 11-25: provisions of a section that lists an R district also apply to that district with a suffix unless the section lists separate provisions for the suffixed districts, which 23-362 does not. This is a reading of 11-25, not an express naming of R6B and not an owner decision: the reviewer (Q12) must confirm it, including 11-25's 'except as otherwise set forth in express provisions of this Resolution'.

This is the ZR 23-362 paragraph (a) 'For standard lots' maximum. Paragraph (b) sets a site-wide maximum (65 percent on zoning lots of 30,000 square feet or more that are not large sites; 50 percent on large sites) for zoning lots with buildings utilizing the eligible-site provisions of Section 23-434; that option, and whether it is available in R6B, is not evaluated here.

Section 23-363, titled 'Special rules for certain interior or through lots' in the captured page's navigation, has not been captured or evaluated; where it applies it may change the 80 percent interior or through lot value.

A commercial overlay is mapped on this lot. This is the R6B residence-district residential lot coverage of ZR 23-362. The commercial-district provisions that apply to buildings in a commercial overlay (ZR Article III) have not been captured or encoded, so a reviewer must confirm this value governs the building proposed, in particular one with non-residential floor area.

A special purpose district is mapped on this lot and may modify residence-district lot coverage; its provisions are not captured or evaluated here, so the value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.

special_district_interactions.description: Special Purpose Districts (ZR Articles VIII-XIV) may modify residence-district lot coverage. When one is mapped, its provisions govern and must be evaluated by the corresponding special rule; this rule does not apply the modification and escalates to professional_review_required via special_district_modification.

uncertainty_policy.note: An uncertain, split, sliver, or invalid M2-T013 geometric district assignment is never collapsed into a single definitive district: coverage downgrades to professional_review_required (or data_conflict) and the geometric uncertainty is recorded in the trace.

limitations: Draft extraction pending independent review and G6 qualified-human legal approval; not a Verified determination.
Only R6B is encoded; ZR 23-362(a) states the same values for the other districts it lists, which are not yet rules.

The lot type is an input for the zoning lot or the portion evaluated; a zoning lot with corner and interior or through portions is evaluated portion by portion by the caller. This rule never splits a lot or decides its type.

Sections 23-363, 23-38 (Special Rules for Certain Areas) and 23-70 (Alternative Bulk Regulations for Certain Areas) - titles as shown in the portal navigation - have not been captured or evaluated; where one applies it may change this value.
